sourceFile: 61.MSU-L20S15-07  Report test material ring plate difference colour level 1 and level 2 from Myungjin vender_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The draft uses valid rows but misgroups the changed factor by mixing material levels with drop-test methods.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly includes auto and manual drop tests as changed conditions.
Drop-test rows lack preserved test-method grouping for level 2 rows.
Decision rows approving use of levels 1 and 2 are omitted from evidence.
Baseline Normal applies only to function check, not drop-test results.
SubgroupKeys are incomplete and biased to level 1 only.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to plate ring colour/material level 1 and level 2 from Myungjin versus Normal where available.
Treat auto and manual drop as outcome/test-method subgroups, not changed factors.
Carry merged date, line, and drop-test method context onto rows 29 and 31.
Add decision and result-summary rows 32-40 to cited evidence.
Separate function comparison with Normal from drop-test pass results without Normal baseline.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Cited rows exist, but final evidence is incomplete until decision rows and corrected grouping citations are added.
